reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is attacker-controlled. Data flow traces from request.getParameterNames() (line 45) through the loop (lines 47-58) where param is set to the parameter name if its value equals 'BenchmarkTest01427'. This param is passed to doSomething (line 60), assigned to bar (line 68), and printed to the writer (line 63) without any HTML encoding or sanitization. Although param defaults to '' if the condition isn't met, an attacker can provide a parameter name containing script tags (e.g. ?<script>x>=BenchmarkTest01427) which propagates to the sink. X-XSS-Protection header disables browser defenses but does not mitigate the underlying taint.
